keyFindings.description: listArchitectureSources reads only the new route, so this release's dispatch CLI against a Dispatch older than 0117 answers every issue create in a project with no architecture source with false advice ('Could not check whether project NOARCH has an architecture model: no route for GET /api/v1/projects/NOARCH/architecture-sources. Review the dispatch skill ...'), reproduced against the base server 83f63201 in the reviewer's lane; the base CLI on the same server prints nothing. This reintroduces the exact defect #1522 fixed (a project with no source reads as none from either server). Fix: on the older server's 404 NOT_FOUND for the list, read the singular GET (200 null or 404 SOURCE_NOT_FOUND -> [], a row -> [row]) and rethrow anything else; lock it with a test; correct the envoy-client CHANGELOG line that documents the false advice.

Removing GET /api/v1/projects/{key}/architecture-source gives every session still on an earlier pi-envoy or claude-envoy the same false advice on every issue create once Dispatch deploys: base CLI 83f63201 against the head server printed 'Could not check whether project NOARCH has an architecture model: no route for GET /api/v1/projects/NOARCH/architecture-source ...' (reproduced); the head CLI on the same server prints nothing. Keep that read route in this release answering its old contract (null without a source, a source row otherwise), described as kept for clients older than this release.

No '## Contract change census' although the PR removes four routes, renames GET /architecture's 'source' to 'sources', removes DispatchClient.getArchitectureSource, changes syncArchitectureSource's signature, drops 'repo' from the PUT body and changes dispatch_architecture_sync's details shape. The census needs its search commands, every hit with a disposition, and a rollout line that is warn-first or an immediate refusal naming the vulnerability it closes.
